title: A City Weighs Three Public-Space Proposals · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference:
A city council in the town of Riverton is considering three proposals for a new public space. The proposals were submitted by local groups, and they are being reviewed by a committee this month. The committee will decide which plan is chosen. Each proposal has strengths and weaknesses, and residents have been invited to share their opinions. Proposal A: A Community Garden
This plan would turn an empty lot near the library into a community garden. The garden would be divided into small plots, and each plot would be rented to a family for a small fee. The money collected would be used to buy tools and seeds. Volunteers would take care of the shared areas. The garden would provide fresh vegetables and a quiet place to relax. However, some residents worry that the garden would attract insects and require a lot of water. Also, the lot is small, so only about twenty families could have plots.

Part 3
